The mv88e6xxx driver currently assumes a single CPU port in the fabric
and thus floods frames with unknown DA on a single DSA port
that is one hop closer to the CPU port.
With multiple CPU ports in mind
column2: this isn't true anymore because CPU

column1: ports could be found behind both DSA ports of a device in-between
For example in a A <-> B <-> C fabric
column2: both A and C having CPU ports

column1: device B will have to flood such frame to its two DSA ports.
This patch considers both CPU and DSA ports of a device as upstream

column2: where to flood frames with unknown DA addresses.
